body:
Add Chinese nine-key Pinyin using the existing `luna_pinyin` dictionary and user dictionary. Enable `luna_pinyin_t9` through the existing scheme selector; both stock themes provide the layout.

Support syllable selection/locking, focus changes, unlock, undo, cancel, literal digits/symbols and editor-boundary reset. Native revisions reject stale spelling actions. Responses keep one bounded spelling snapshot alongside the existing batched candidate response. Related #1464, #1299 and #459.

**Draft: the maintainer-requested physical-device verification remains NOT RUN.**

Head `8a1ee0ea` is rebased onto upstream `a047f747`, with four linear Conventional Commits. The obsolete local #2187 candidate change was dropped in favor of the version merged upstream. Included Unicode and deferred-view dependencies match the reviewed #2186 and #2188 changes. The scheme-restoration and editor-required ASCII fixes remain. Fork release/Pages configuration, prediction, privacy policy and candidate pinning remain outside this PR.

Validation for this source:

- [Upstream CI](https://github.com/osfans/trime/actions/runs/40527129836): all five jobs succeeded, including unit-test and Lint tasks. The workflow did not export a precise application test count.
- Fresh host checks passed 743 T9 assertions, 115 Unicode CheckJNI assertions and 46 UTF-16 offset assertions. The recorded host librime engine was reused; the current T9 test programs were rebuilt.
- Original four-ABI Debug APKs were audited without modification or re-signing. Their actual producer is merge `0ef0eb55`, whose complete Git tree equals head `8a1ee0ea`; build metadata and APK bytes are not claimed to be direct-head builds.
- The same original x86_64 Debug APK completed the targeted 12 sessions/14 logical checks on Android 5.0 and Android 15 r2, with 134 captures and 110 strict editor-text pairs per system. Both VMs shut down normally; the Android 15 log collector returned 255 on ADB disconnect, a retained capture limitation. The earlier API35 attempt had system startup ANRs and two low-watermark kills before Trime startup; that failed attempt remains recorded.

Dependency/tool, Debug-signature and runtime diagnostics remain documented; no zero-warning, Release, performance or physical-device acceptance is claimed. The 44 physical-device result fields remain NOT_RUN, so this PR stays Draft.

[Input behavior and switching contract](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/blob/8a1ee0ea6538e220fcddf31ed6fd491f5bc3cca7/doc/t9-input.md).
